items.title: Bitcoin will become ‘less volatile’ and larger than gold: ‘The Bitcoin Standard’ author
items.summary: Saifedean Ammous argues that Bitcoin already functions as money when held as a store of value; expects it will become larger and less volatile than gold as it matures.

items.title: Kraken Owner Payward to Buy Lithuania's Saldo Bank in EU Push
items.summary: Co-CEO Arjun Sethi says customers want cash, crypto, tokenized stocks and credit in one place, starting with lending and cards.

items.title: Standard Chartered expands Bitcoin and Ether trading to professional investors in UAE
items.summary: Standard Chartered expanded its spot crypto trading services to professional investors in the UAE region, with plans to offer access to more market participants.

items.title: BitMEX Sued in UK for Return of $27M in Bitcoin Over Unlicensed Derivatives
items.summary: The claim challenges 1,053 loss-making perpetual swap trades from 2018 to 2022 and also accuses the now-closed exchange of deceit.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin tumbles from near $84,000 ahead of U.S. inflation data
items.summary: A brief run at $84,000 faded within the hour as tech stocks stalled and the chip selloff rolled on. Traders are waiting on the September CPI print.

items.title: Proposed French tax on regulated stablecoins could drive crypto traders offshore
items.summary: Chainalysis CEO in France Francois Volpoet warned the proposed 31.4% tax on regulated stablecoins could push traders toward unmonitored offshore channels.

items.title: Standard Chartered unlocks direct bitcoin and ether trading for affluent UAE clients
items.summary: The bank manages custody and settlement in-house via a closed-loop model, removing the need for separate crypto wallets.

items.title: Coinbase, which holds 5% of all bitcoin, wants the quantum fix started now
items.summary: Coinbase says bitcoin should start preparing for quantum computers now, with flexible addresses, a backup quantum-proof key and a separate debate over lost coins.

items.title: Starknet introduces wallet privacy feature for DeFi activity
items.summary: Starknet’s Shadow Accounts allow users to obscure connections between their main wallets and DeFi activity, though transactions remain visible onchain.

items.title: Fed’s Williams sees AI supply squeeze lasting beyond 2 years
items.summary: New York Fed President John Williams’ comments came as he reaffirmed his view that the US Federal Reserve may need to raise interest rates once more this year.

items.title: Ripple adds Stripe-owned wallets to XRP Ledger as AI payments pass 14 million
items.summary: The integration will let software pay for online services using XRP and RLUSD, while questions remain about how much real economic activity the transactions represent.

items.title: Solana sets Oct. 21 for Alpenglow upgrade targeting 150-millisecond finality
items.summary: The switch will replace Solana’s existing validator voting system, remove vote transactions from blocks and could sharply change headline transaction counts even if user activity stays flat.

items.title: Bitcoin climbs toward $84,000 after Fed’s Williams sees no rate hikes in 2027
items.summary: ZEC led a broad bounce among major tokens, and Korean chipmakers snapped a five-day losing streak ahead of Thursday’s U.S. inflation data.

items.title: Coinbase lays out flexible designs as key priority for Bitcoin’s post-quantum migration
items.summary: Coinbase published priorities for Bitcoin's post-quantum transition, urging early preparation for signature upgrades and fund migration.

items.title: Bitwise’s Hougan says Q3 charts point to ‘crypto spring’
items.summary: Bitwise’s Matt Hougan said nearly every fundamental indicator that Bitwise tracks spiked sharply higher.

items.title: Largest Philippines crypto exchange, Coins.ph, said to face central bank regulatory action
items.summary: The exchange, which has over 18 million customers, is said to have handled business transactions involving restricted offshore gaming and gambling companies.

items.title: Ledger asks resellers to halt sales in Southeast Asia and Hong Kong
items.summary: The wallet maker requested that devices be removed from shelves while investigators work to establish where tampering occurred.

items.title: Strive raising $500 million to buy additional bitcoin with new preferred share class
items.summary: SATS will offer a fixed 15% dividend yield at par and be junior to the company's existing SATA, which pays a variable rate (currently 13%).

items.title: Kraken Parent Payward Wins Full Dubai License, Plans UAE Launch
items.summary:
Bitcoin Magazine  
  
 Kraken Parent Payward Wins Full Dubai License, Plans UAE Launch  
 Kraken currently has more than 100 licenses and registrations worldwide.  
 This post  Kraken Parent Payward Wins Full Dubai License, Plans UAE Launch  first appeared on  Bitcoin Magazine  and is written by  Mathew Di Salvo .

items.title: Researchers Build First Working Post-Quantum Defense for Bitcoin’s Lightning Network
items.summary:
Bitcoin Magazine  
  
 Researchers Build First Working Post-Quantum Defense for Bitcoin’s Lightning Network  
 Second-layer solutions like Lightning may also need protection from quantum computers. Here’s how a research team appears to have cracked it.  
 This post  Researchers Build First Working Post-Quantum Defense for Bitcoin’s Lightning Network  first appeared on  Bitcoin Magazine  and is written by  Mathew Di Salvo .

items.title: BNY, Citadel Securities test tokenized U.S. Treasuries to speed up Wall Street financing
items.summary: The transaction shows how blockchain-based government bonds could help trading firms move collateral faster between settlement and financing.

items.title: OpenAI Engineer Arrested for Bugging Office, Company Says AI Caught Him
items.summary: A Saudi national working at OpenAI allegedly hid an encrypted audio recorder behind a TV in an executive meeting room. OpenAI says its own models helped trace it back to him.

items.title: Character.AI Files for Bankruptcy as Disney Bids $20 Million—And Users Get Grief Resources
items.summary: The chatbot app once valued at $1 billion is up for sale in a Delaware court, two weeks after launching new models. If nobody buys it, it shuts down.

items.title: Binance Is Shutting Down Its Bitcoin Mining Pool After Six Years
items.summary: Binance will discontinue Binance Pool, Pool Savings, Cloud Mining, and other related services in a retreat from mining infrastructure.

items.title: Most tokenized stock trading on Solana, BNB Chain occurs outside US market hours
items.summary: Tokenized equities have reached nearly $3.3 billion in value as investors embrace round-the-clock access beyond Wall Street hours.
